title: Spicy Aji Pasta
description: A quick and spicy Mexican pasta dish made with aji peppers, crunchy texture, and umami flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the umami sauce over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped aji peppers to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes or until they start to soften.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the aji peppers and umami sauce.
Sprinkle the crushed tortilla chips on top of the pasta and toss again to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: top with cilantro, lime wedges, or extra aji peppers.
